title: M8 · The shared time list
intro: One time list for every section, as the design review decided (rulebook v1.019, picture 14b): Star's list, every 5 minutes, AM/PM on every time, opening with the chosen time in the middle; 6:00 AM–10:00 PM for classes, testing and camps; Finance's reminder keeps Off and 11 AM–11 PM. The same list on every device — not the phone's own picker (v0.51). It is built on the shared dropdown (Star's, made shared, v1.100). Amber outline = what the shared list decides. Two details to OK: (a) the row the arrow keys are on gets the blue focus ring (3) — today's dropdowns show only a faint gray there; (b) typing a number jumps to that hour — “6” → 6:00 AM, “6” again → 6:00 PM (2). Every state at all four sizes: M8-time-list.png.

footer: What changes for each section when it switches (later, in its own prompt): Color Belt, Camps and Finance swap the browser's own list for this one, and Schedule and Calendar drop the browser's time box (v1.019) · Star's and Black Belt's lists go from 15 to 5 minutes, and Star's range from 8 AM–8 PM to 6 AM–10 PM · the database checks that still accept only 15-minute steps (Star, Black Belt, Finance) are widened in those sections' prompts — none in this step.
